text: The program features cross-cutting collaboration across World Bank Group units and partnerships with organizations like GFDRR and InsuResilience Global Partnership. It emphasizes public-private partnerships to strengthen catastrophe insurance markets and integrates disaster risk financing with macro-fiscal policy and preparedness. The Financial Protection Forum serves as a knowledge platform to disseminate best practices.

metadata.solution_name: World Bank Group’s Disaster Risk Financing and Insurance Program (DRFI/DRFIP)
